Peak Performance International | Equine Chiropractic & Performance

This channel explores equine biomechanics, chiropractic care, and performance optimization for horses and riders.

Led by Dr. Arianna Aaron, DC, IVCA, we share educational videos on horse movement, spinal health, rehabilitation strategies, and hands-on treatment techniques used to help performance horses move comfortably and perform at their highest level.

You will learn about:

• Equine chiropractic adjustments
• Horse biomechanics and movement analysis
• Common causes of poor performance in horses
• Rehabilitation and strengthening exercises
• Evidence-based strategies to support soundness and longevity

Whether you are a rider, trainer, veterinarian, or horse owner, this channel helps you understand how the equine body functions and how to keep horses performing comfortably.

Subscribe to learn how better biomechanics leads to better performance, healthier horses, and longer careers.
